name: Vengeful Rom
body:
VENGEFUL ROM
CR 7

The insubstantial form of a giant in primitive garb stands before you. You can feel the rage and hatred of a thousand years burning through you from its eyes.

It points a withered finger accusingly and wildly swings its club above its head.

XP 3,200
N Huge undead (giant, augmented humanoid, incorporeal)
Init +0; Senses low-light vision, darkvision 60 feet, ethereal sight; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 5, flat-footed 15 (+10 natural, –2 size)
hp 59 (7d8+28)
Fort +6, Ref +2, Will +6
Defensive Abilities ethereal travel; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee spectral greatclub +9 (3d8+6/19–20 bludgeoning)
Ranged spectral tree javelin +14 (2d10+10 piercing, range 60 feet)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks corrupting gaze, malevolence

STATISTICS

Str 23, Dex 10, Con -, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 18
Base Atk +5; CMB +13; CMD 23
Feats Power Attack, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Overrun, Intimidating Prowess
Skills Skills: Climb +20, Intimidate +5, Knowledge (nature) +5, Knowledge (religion) +5, Perception +11, Sense Motive +11, Stealth +6, Survival +8
Languages Common, Giant

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Ethereal Sight (Su)

A vengeful rom can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

Incorporeal Movement (Ex)

A vengeful rom can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside and object.

Ethereal Travel (Su)

A vengeful rom enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can’t affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

Corrupting Gaze (Su)

The vengeful rom is disfigured through age or violence, and has a gaze attack with a range of 40 feet that causes 2d10 damage and 1d4 Charisma damage (Fortitude save negates Charisma damage but not physical damage).

Malevolence (Su)

The vengeful rom’s jealousy of the living is particularly potent. Once per round, the rom can merge its body with a creature on the Material Plane. This ability is similar to a magic jar spell (caster level 10th), except that it does not require a receptacle.

To use this ability, the rom must be adjacent to the target.

The target can resist the attack with a successful Will save. A creature that successfully saves is immune to that same rom’s malevolence for 24 hours.

ECOLOGY

Environment forests, jungles
Organization solitary, gang (2-5), band (6-8), or raiding party (9-12)
Treasure standard

Most rom are content to leave the smaller folk alone and in turn be left alone. But humanoids have killed many of their kind or driven them out of their lands. Some of those Rom who have been killed become ghosts, seeking vengeance against those who have wronged them.
